BACHELOR OF PHARMACY WITH HONOURS


Programme Overview

The Bachelor of Pharmacy (Hons) degree programme that is offered by the University of Malaya holds true to the following philosophy, which is in line with the nation’s requirements. The programme offers a broad-based curriculum and training with opportunities for specialisation. The programme supports evidence-based practices and consists of dynamic characteristics with room for future advancement.


Duration: 4 years( 8 semester ), Full time (Coursework)

Career Prospects

Community Pharmacist, Hospital Pharmacist, Clinical Pharmacist, Industrial Pharmacist, Regulatory Affairs Officer, Pharmaceutical Sales Representative, Research Scientist, Quality Control Analyst, Drug Safety Associate, Pharmacovigilance Officer, Academic Lecturer, Medical Science Liaison, Formulation Scientist, Production Pharmacist, Compounding Pharmacist, Public Health Pharmacist, Clinical Trials Coordinator, Healthcare Consultant, Toxicologist, Pharmacy Benefits Analyst.

Entry Requirement

SPM / O-Level / Equivalent Subject Requirements:

  • Obtain at least  Grade B in FIVE (5) of the following subjects: 
    • English, Biology, Chemistry, Physics & Mathematics / Additional Mathematics
STPM (Science Stream)
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Obtain a minimum CGPA of 3.80
  • Obtained at least Grade A in TWO (2) subjects and Grade A- in ONE (1) subject at STPM level; Biology, Chemistry, Physics / Mathematics (M) / Mathematics (T)
Matriculation / Foundation (Science Stream)
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Obtain a minimum CGPA of 3.80
  • Obtained at least Grade A in TWO (2) subjects and Grade A- in ONE (1) subject at Matriculation/Foundation level; Biology, Chemistry, Physics / Mathematics
STAM
  • Not Offered
Diploma / Equivalent (UPU)
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Possess a Diploma in Pharmacy or Science recognized by the Government of Malaysia and approved by the University Malaya Senate with a minimum CGPA of 3.80;
  • Obtained at least Grade B in THREE (3) subjects at Diploma level; Biology, Chemistry, Physics / Mathematics
UM (SATU)Foundations
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Obtain a minimum CGPA of 3.80
  • Obtained at least Grade A in TWO (2) subjects and Grade A- in ONE (1) subject at UM SATU Foundation level; Biology, Chemistry, Physics / Mathematics
GCE A-Level
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Obtain a recognized GCE A-Level qualification
  • Obtained at least ONE (1) Grade A and TWO (2) Grade B in any of the following subjects; Biology, Chemistry, Physics / Mathematics
International Baccalaureate (IB)
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Obtain a minimum score of 36 points
  • Obtained at least Grade 6 at the Higher Level (HL) in the following subjects: Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics / Physics
AUSMAT
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Obtain a minimum score of 90 in the Australian Tertiary Admissions Rank (ATAR).
  • Obtain at least a grade of B in Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics / Physics
STPM (not from the current year)
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Obtain a minimum CGPA of 3.80
  • Obtained at least Grade A in TWO (2) subjects and Grade A- in ONE (1) subject at the STPM level; Biology, Chemistry, Physics / Mathematics (M) / Mathematics (T)
Matriculation/Foundation (not from the current year)
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Obtain a minimum CGPA of 3.80
  • Obtained at least Grade A in TWO (2) subjects and Grade A- in ONE (1) subject at the Matriculation / Foundation level; Biology, Chemistry, Physics / Mathematics
IPTS Foundation
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Obtain a minimum CGPA of 3.80 at the IPTS Foundation / Pre-Pharmacy / Pre-Medical / Foundation in Science level
  • Obtained at least Grade A in TWO (2) subjects and Grade A- in ONE (1) subject at the IPTS Foundation / Pre-Pharmacy / Pre-Medical / Foundation in Science level; Biology, Chemistry, Physics / Mathematics
Entry Requirements 9
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Possess international entry qualifications recognized by the Government of Malaysia / Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA) / Malaysian Pharmacy Board (LFM);
  • Obtained at least Grade A in TWO (2) subjects and Grade A- in ONE (1) subject in the following: Biology, Chemistry, Physics / Mathematics
Entry Requirements 10
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Possess a Bachelor’s Degree in Science recognized by the Government of Malaysia and approved by the University of Malaya Senate with a minimum CGPA of 3.50

    • Chemistry 80% (A) / 65% (B)
    • Physics / Mathematics 80% (A) / 65% (B)

    • Biology 80% (A/A-)
    • Chemistry 80% (A/A-)
    • Physics / Mathematics 80% (A/A-)
GCE A-Level
  • Obtain a GCE A-Level with a minimum of two (2) Grade A and one (1) Grade B (AAB) in the following three (3) subjects:
    • Biology(A/B)
    • Chemistry(A/B)
    • Physics / Mathematics(A/B)

Additional Requirement

  • Interview are required for this course
  • Test are required for this course
  • Certified healthy from serious physical disabilities and mental illness (exceptions may be given to candidates who have physical disabilities that can be corrected and / or do not prevent candidates from conducting clinical activities required by medical practitioners)
  • Candidates who apply must be physically fit, not suffering from any mental or physical illness and able to follow the program of study designed for this course.

English Language Requirements

  • Obtain a minimum of Band 3.0 in MUET for examinations starting from Session 1 of the year 2021, or Band 3.0 for examinations up to the year 2020, according to the validity period on the date of application
  • Applicants without MUET but with the following results may be considered for conditional admission, provided they fulfil MUET requirement within ONE (1) academic session:
    • Obtain at least Band 4.5 (Academic) in IELTS; or
    • Obtain a minimum score of 33 in TOEFL iBT (Centre-based)
  • MUET 4.0
  • IELTS (Academic) 5.5
  • TOEFL iBT (Centre-based) 46
  • TOEFL Essentials (Online) 8.0
  • Pearson Test of English (PTE Academic) 51
  • Cambridge English Qualifications & Tests B1 Preliminary, B2 First, C1 Advanced, C2 Proficiency 160
